description: This Java source file defines an integration test class `LoanRepaymentRescheduleAtDisbursementTest` for testing loan repayment rescheduling at disbursement within the Apache Fineract project. It contains setup methods and a test case that creates clients, loan products, applies for loans, disburses loans, and validates the repayment schedule adjustments.
